tomorrow.title: Tomorrow
tomorrow.author: Scott Buckley
tomorrow.notes: Bright, playful orchestral fantasy. Title promises a joyful adventure.

childhood.title: Childhood
childhood.author: Scott Buckley
childhood.notes: Tender, innocent piano and strings for story and Muling; sadness must remain gentle and resolve toward hope.

life-in-silico.title: Life in Silico
life-in-silico.author: Scott Buckley
life-in-silico.notes: Bubbly piano and strings for domestic warmth; check that the bittersweet ending does not dominate.

concerning-hobbits.title: Concerning Hobbits
concerning-hobbits.author: Scott Buckley
concerning-hobbits.notes: Carefree classical adventure; this is Buckley's own piece, not the film soundtrack.

quirky-lane.title: Quirky Lane
quirky-lane.author: Scott Buckley
quirky-lane.notes: Warm recorder and strings, then playful winds and vibes; bustling harbor, not slapstick.

enchanted-valley.title: Enchanted Valley
enchanted-valley.author: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
enchanted-valley.notes: Existing forest-only candidate. Preserve previously imported recording.

an-unexpected-party.title: An Unexpected Party
an-unexpected-party.author: Scott Buckley
an-unexpected-party.notes: Playful chamber orchestration for a lively workshop; reject if it sounds too comedic.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.author: Scott Buckley
discovery.notes: Optimistic flight adventure; verify hybrid synth/brass do not overwhelm relaxed exploration.

reverie.title: Reverie
reverie.author: Scott Buckley
reverie.notes: Dreamlike intimacy for library and revelations; no horror or persistent melancholy.

golden-hour.title: Golden Hour
golden-hour.author: Scott Buckley
golden-hour.notes: Warm mystery and discovery instead of ominous suspense.

jubilee.title: Jubilee
jubilee.author: Scott Buckley
jubilee.notes: Buoyant orchestral adventure; ordinary combat feels like a challenge, not danger music.

into-the-wilds.title: Into The Wilds
into-the-wilds.author: Scott Buckley
into-the-wilds.notes: Heroic fantasy combat with positive momentum; reject sustained threat or excessive brass.

call-to-adventure.title: Call To Adventure
call-to-adventure.author: Scott Buckley
call-to-adventure.notes: Heroic theme with softer middle and triumphant resolution; finale escalation only.

where-stars-fall.title: Where Stars Fall
where-stars-fall.author: Scott Buckley
where-stars-fall.notes: Uplifting orchestral resolution, reserved for the final climax; not general exploration.

direction: Joyful cat fantasy adventure; warmth, curiosity and hope take priority over cinematic scale. Even twists must remain emotionally safe and ultimately uplifting.
